customMethods.script:
userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	navInfo = self.view.custom.navInfo
	if navInfo['viewPath'] == 'kanoa/core/config/navTreeEditor': 
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'This item cannot be deleted'})
		return
	
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.config.deleteNavigationItem(navInfo['id'], userId)
	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': "navInfo. %s"%msg})
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Navigation item has been deleted'})
		
	self.view.params.value.id = None
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.navInfo")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.navItems")
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshNavigation', {})	#Tells the navigation dock view to update itself

	return

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("confirmMoveNavItem() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	draggedItem = payload['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['droppedItem']
	if droppedItem is None: droppedItem = {'id': None}
	
	system.perspective.print("Checking permissions() %s"%self.view.custom.userAction)
	if not self.view.custom.userAction.canCreate: 
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.navItems")
		return
	
	if draggedItem['id'] is None or draggedItem['id'] == droppedItem['id']: 
		#We somehow managed to dropped an item onto itself
		system.perspective.print("Invalid move. Ignoring...")
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.navItems")
		return

	system.perspective.print("Moving %s to parentId %s"%(draggedItem['path'],  droppedItem['id']))
	navInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.config.getNavigation({'id': draggedItem['id']}),0)
	if navInfo['roles']: navInfo['roles'] = system.util.jsonDecode(navInfo['roles'])
	if navInfo['project']: navInfo['project'] = system.util.jsonDecode(navInfo['project'])	
	navInfo['parentId'] = droppedItem['id']
	
	self.view.custom.navInfo = navInfo
	system.perspective.print(navInfo['roles'])
	self.save()
	
	return

system.perspective.print("navTreeEditorItemSelected msg rcvd with payload %s"%(payload))
	
	if payload['msgHandler'] == 'navTreeEditorItemSelected':
		item = payload['selection']
		self.view.params.value.id = item[0]['value']['id'] if len(item) > 0 and item[0]['value'].has_key('id') else None
	
	return
